text: Some people build websites. Others build experiences that feel alive.
Meet Sahnawaz Ahmed Laskar, full-stack developer and UI designer.
His portfolio isn't a brochure. It's a living product: fast, smart, and designed end to end.
He builds real products. This website, StudyLens AI, a homework helper for students, and YojanaSahay, a free government scheme finder used across India.
And these numbers aren't screenshots. They're pulled live from each product, right now.
His journey began in customer support at Xiaomi and Flipkart, then an IT and developer role at Rapido.
Every milestone opens into its full story, from GitHub contributions to his signature Hacker Mode.
His toolkit: React and JavaScript up front, Node and Firebase behind, and Figma for design.
Every change ships through GitHub and goes live in about a minute, with build health and security checked live.
Need something built? Each service flips open to show a clear starting price and exactly what's included.
Already have a website? A free check shows your phone speed, Google basics and WhatsApp preview in about thirty seconds.
And the managers and team leads he's worked with say it best.
Got a question? His AI assistant knows his work and answers instantly, day or night.
Let's build something remarkable. Visit sahnawaz-portfolio.vercel.app
